description: This file defines a singly linked list class with basic operations such as add, remove, size, and get, along with an internal Node class and a helper function to find the tail of the list.

classes.name: LinkedList
classes.description: A singly linked list implementation with methods for adding, removing, getting size, and retrieving elements by index.

classes.name: LinkedList.Node
classes.description: Private nested class representing a node in the linked list, holding data and a reference to the next node.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds an element to the end of the linked list.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the first occurrence of an element from the linked list.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of elements in the linked list.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the element at the specified index.

methods.name: unlink
methods.description: Private method that unlinks a node from the list, updating references accordingly.

methods.name: tail
methods.description: Companion object method that finds the last node in the list starting from the given head.
